fixed.member: og cook: normal and linear textures
fixed.summary: UASTC textures (normal maps, metallic-roughness, occlusion, masks, and colour under `cook { color_textures uastc }`) encode at the level the options set: the basis-universal binding ORed the level over its default, so the default level 1 encoded as level 3 (slower). They now encode at level 1, about three times faster, with RDO 1.0 as before; level 0 of a 1024x1024 map measures 0.05 to 0.5 dB lower PSNR. Every UASTC texture recooks once.
